reason: A Windows-native DeepSeek Harness agent preset that adapts routing and selectively exposes tools while supporting file operations, PowerShell, Git Bash, workflows, jobs, and subagents; its documented unsandboxed shell execution warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 面向 Windows 原生 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应 Agent Preset，可按任务路由并按需启用文件、PowerShell、Git Bash、工作流、后台任务和子代理能力。
summaries.en: A Windows-native DeepSeek Harness agent preset that adapts task routing and selectively enables file tools, PowerShell, Git Bash, workflows, background jobs, and subagents.

capabilities: Adaptive agent routing and persona configuration
On-demand discovery and unlocking of tools
Windows PowerShell and Git Bash command execution
File operations through read, write, edit, glob, and grep tools
Background jobs, workflows, goals, and subagent support
